submissions.note: FULL PLAN AT THE GATE, gold-clocked with a staging margin. Two lessons are folded in. (1) Latency: my answer takes tens of seconds against a 30s wave, so no trigger may be true when it lands — the purse is 0 now, so every threshold below is safely in the future. (2) waveGte was the wrong clock: a wave arrives whether or not the purse can pay, and attempt 2 lost two turrets that way. goldGte is the right clock because affordability IS the trigger — the reflex layer pre-arms the moment gold covers the price, and the margin above the price is the seconds it needs to walk, open the menu and park the mouse. Prices are 50/70/95/125, so triggers 62/85/110/142 each leave ~4s of staging at ~3.3 gold/s. Cells all sit inside 5.2wu of a seam so the pan keeps paying while the aim is held: (-6,7) NW, (2,-5) S, (5,7) E, (-4,-4) SW. Four turrets at 16wu blanket the middle and the stake at (0,12) before the 25-33 jumper waves. BUILDs lead the list; the retreat trigger is last so it cannot starve them.

Purse 60 against a 62 trigger — the first turret fires within a second, long before this answer can land, so it is dropped from the restatement. NOTE THE DSL COST THIS EXPOSES: a submission REPLACES the whole record set, so every re-command must restate the entire remaining plan and must guess what fired during my own latency. Rest unchanged: S (2,-5) at 85, E (5,7) at 110, SW (-4,-4) at 142, retreat inside the ring at 20+.

UNFREEZE. Two whole waves paid nothing: goldDelta 0 across waves 1 and 2, purse stuck at 60. Cause is mine, and it is a doctrine finding — I named cells beside the seams that were live AT THE GATE, but seams cycle, and by wave 2 the (-9,6.7) seam had gone cold. The reflex layer, holding an aim it could not abandon, stood on ground that pays nothing while waiting for a gold trigger only panning could deliver. A gold-clocked BUILD whose cell has drifted away from a live seam is a self-blocking order. Re-aiming both cells at the seams that are live RIGHT NOW — (7.5,6.5) — so the pan funds the trigger it is waiting for: (5,7) at 75 and (9,4) at 105, both inside 3wu of that seam, both reaching the stake at (0,12) with their 16wu. Third turret parked out west beside the other live seam (-22,-6.8) as a fallback purchase. Retreat trigger unchanged.
